#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <stack>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <memory>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

// IntList wrapper around std::vector<int>
class IntList {
public:
    vector<int> data;

    IntList() {}

    bool isEmpty() const { return data.empty(); }
    int size() const { return data.size(); }
    int get(int index) const {
        if (index < 0 || index >= (int)data.size()) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        return data[index];
    }
    void clear() { data.clear(); }
    void set(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= (int)data.size()) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        data[index] = value;
    }
    void expand() {
        // Not needed, vector handles growth
    }
    void insert(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index > (int)data.size()) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        data.insert(data.begin() + index, value);
    }
    int delete_at(int index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= (int)data.size()) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        int value = data[index];
        data.erase(data.begin() + index);
        return value;
    }
    void push(int value) {
        data.push_back(value);
    }
    int pop() {
        if (data.empty()) throw runtime_error("No such element");
        int value = data.back();
        data.pop_back();
        return value;
    }
    void unshift(int value) {
        data.insert(data.begin(), value);
    }
    int shift() {
        if (data.empty()) throw runtime_error("No such element");
        int value = data.front();
        data.erase(data.begin());
        return value;
    }
};

struct Frame {
    int from, to, state;
    shared_ptr<IntList> left, right, result;

    Frame(int from, int to) : from(from), to(to), state(0) {}
};

int n, m;

shared_ptr<IntList> buildBase(int from) {
    auto res = make_shared<IntList>();
    res->push(from);
    if (from + m > n) {
        res->push(n - from);
        res->push(from - n);
    }
    res->push(m);
    if (from > m) {
        res->push(n - from);
        res->push(from);
    }
    res->push(-from);
    return res;
}

shared_ptr<IntList> merge(shared_ptr<IntList> a, shared_ptr<IntList> b) {
    auto res = make_shared<IntList>();
    int aSize = a->size();
    int bSize = b->size();
    int* aData = a->data.data();
    int* bData = b->data.data();
    for (int i = 0;; i += 2) {
        int bFrom = (i == 0) ? 0 : bData[i - 1];
        int bTo = (i == bSize - 1) ? n : bData[i + 1];
        int bShift = bData[i];
        int aFrom = bFrom + bShift;
        int aTo = bTo + bShift;
        int l = 0;
        int r = aSize - 1;
        while (l < r) {
            int m = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
            if (aData[m] <= aFrom) {
                l = m + 1;
            } else {
                r = m - 1;
            }
        }
        int cur = l;
        while (true) {
            res->push(bShift + aData[cur]);
            ++cur;
            if (cur == aSize) break;
            int pos = aData[cur];
            if (pos >= aTo) break;
            res->push(pos - bShift);
            ++cur;
        }
        if (i == bSize - 1) break;
        res->push(bTo);
    }
    return res;
}

shared_ptr<IntList> solve(int from, int to) {
    stack<Frame> st;
    st.push(Frame(from, to));
    while (!st.empty()) {
        Frame& f = st.top();
        if (f.state == 2) {
            f.result = merge(f.left, f.right);
            st.pop();
            if (st.empty()) return f.result;
            Frame& p = st.top();
            p.state++;
            if (p.state == 1) {
                p.left = f.result;
            } else {
                p.right = f.result;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (f.from + 1 == f.to) {
            f.result = buildBase(f.from);
            st.pop();
            if (st.empty()) return f.result;
            Frame& p = st.top();
            p.state++;
            if (p.state == 1) {
                p.left = f.result;
            } else {
                p.right = f.result;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (f.state == 0) {
            int mid = (f.from + f.to) >> 1;
            st.push(Frame(mid, f.to));
            st.push(Frame(f.from, mid));
            continue;
        }
        // state == 1, just continue (should not happen)
        continue;
    }
    return nullptr;
}

void solve() {
    cin >> n >> m;
    int s;
    long long t;
    cin >> s >> t;
    s--; // convert to 0-index
    // simulate t % n steps
    long long ct = t % n;
    for (; ct != 0; ct--) {
        if (s < m) {
            s += ct;
            if (s >= n) s -= n;
        } else {
            s -= ct;
            if (s < 0) s += n;
        }
    }
    long long cycles = t / n;
    if (cycles > 0) {
        auto cycleSolve = solve(0, n);
        int csSize = cycleSolve->size();
        int* csData = cycleSolve->data.data();
        auto cycleList = make_shared<IntList>();
        unordered_map<int, int> cycleMap;
        for (long long it = 0;; it++) {
            if (it == cycles) break;
            auto itMap = cycleMap.find(s);
            if (itMap != cycleMap.end()) {
                int prev = itMap->second;
                s = cycleList->get(prev + (int)((cycles - prev) % (it - prev)));
                break;
            }
            cycleList->push(s);
            cycleMap[s] = (int)it;
            int l = 0;
            int r = csSize - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int m = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (csData[m] <= s) {
                    l = m + 1;
                } else {
                    r = m - 1;
                }
            }
            s += csData[l];
        }
    }
    cout << (s + 1) << endl;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    solve();
    return 0;
}
